methodologyNotes: Covers powered impact wrenches with a square drive sold at a published US price, spanning cordless (battery), pneumatic (air), and corded-electric tools. Excludes impact drivers (hex quick-change bit holders), manual breaker bars, and torque multipliers. Price is US MSRP or typical street price for the bare tool in USD; priceNote records whether the figure is bare-tool or kit. driveSizeIn is the square anvil drive size in inches as an enum (0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.75, 1). powerSource is an enum: cordless, pneumatic, or corded-electric. voltageV is nominal battery platform voltage in volts (cordless only); null for pneumatic and corded-electric. maxFasteningTorqueNm is the manufacturer-rated maximum fastening (working) torque in newton-metres. maxBreakawayTorqueNm is the rated nut-busting / breakaway (loosening) torque in newton-metres; null if not disclosed. noLoadSpeedRpm is the maximum no-load rotational speed in revolutions per minute (top gear). impactsPerMinute is the maximum blows/impacts per minute (IPM/BPM). speedSettings is the count of selectable speed or torque modes as an integer (1 for single-speed). motorType is an enum: brushless, brushed, or pneumatic. lengthIn is the head-to-tail tool length in inches. weightLbs is bare-tool weight in pounds, excluding battery. soundPressureDb is the rated A-weighted sound pressure level in dBA; null if not disclosed.
